title: UCP alternative path: 3DS2 step-up through actions (authentication extension)
summary: With dev.ucp.common.payment.authentication negotiated, the business can answer a complete with complete_in_progress and an action for device data collection or a 3DS challenge. The platform runs the browser surface, the surface reports back, and the platform confirms the outcome with Get Checkout. UCP does not carry EMV 3DS messages itself.

steps.label: POST .../complete
steps.detail: Both sides listed the authentication extension, which extends checkout.

steps.label: Authorize; issuer wants 3DS
steps.detail: The business, its handler and its PSP own the 3DS protocol state. UCP only carries the action that lets the platform show the right surface.

steps.label: complete_in_progress + action
steps.detail: The response has an actions object keyed by action type. Each entry has an id and a config naming the payment instrument and the URL to open. At most one authentication action should be outstanding per payment attempt.

steps.label: Show the challenge surface
steps.detail: The buyer completes the issuer challenge. The embedded surface reports action.ready, then action.done or action.error.

steps.label: GET /checkout-sessions/chk_123
steps.detail: The action completion signal is not authoritative, so the platform must confirm with Get Checkout that the business removed the action or changed the status.

failures.outcome: The business returns incomplete or requires_escalation; the platform must not reprocess the same action id unless its contract allows it.

steps.label: completed with order
steps.detail: Authentication succeeded and the order exists.
